numerical_failure.observed_behavior: For `boundary_conditions="periodic"`, `lap.eigenvectors()` contains incorrect (duplicate) eigenvectors, causing an allclose check involving full eigendecomposition to fail (AssertionError).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: `lap.eigenvectors()` should be correct eigenvectors so that the full eigendecomposition reconstructs the Laplacian matrix: `lap.eigenvectors() @ np.diag(lap.eigenvalues()) @ lap.eigenvectors().T` should equal `lap.toarray()` (within `np.allclose`).
trigger_conditions: Run the full eigendecomposition reconstruction check: `np.allclose(lap.eigenvectors() @ np.diag(lap.eigenvalues()) @ lap.eigenvectors().T, lap.toarray())`

oracle_clues: The PR states the implementation does not return correct eigenvectors for `boundary_conditions="periodic"` and that there are clearly duplicate eigenvectors.
Correctness is judged by `np.allclose` of the full eigendecomposition reconstruction: `lap.eigenvectors() @ np.diag(lap.eigenvalues()) @ lap.eigenvectors().T` equals `lap.toarray()`.

category_specific_evidence: Test updates add numerical orthogonality and full eigendecomposition checks: assert_allclose(eigenvectors @ eigenvectors.T, np.eye(n), atol=atol) and assert_allclose(L, lap.toarray(), atol=atol), where L = eigenvectors @ np.diag(eigenvalues) @ eigenvectors.T.
BUG description: "sparse.linalg.LaplacianNd: periodic eigenvectors" and PR text says the existing test is modified to more robustly test that the matrix is recovered by the full eigendecomposition.

Code change in _ev1d modifies eigenvector construction for (j+1) parity in the periodic case: new branch sets i = np.pi * (np.arange(n) + 0.5) / n and ev = np.sqrt(2. / n) * np.sin(i * (j + 1)); the else branch changes from using i = 2. * np.pi * (np.arange(n) + 0.5) / n and cosine of floor((j+1)/2) to i = np.pi * (np.arange(n) + 0.5) / n and ev = np.sqrt(2. / n) * np.cos(i * j).

PR body shows a concrete allclose failure via an example numeric eigenvector/eigendecomposition mismatch: the provided 6x6 matrix values (starting with 0.408, 0.289, 0.289, 0.5, 0.5, 0.408 in the first row) lead to an AssertionError from np.allclose when comparing np.diag-eigendecomposition to lap.toarray().
reproduction_risks: Because the only explicit numerical formulas and failing example in the passages are partial (no full lap.toarray() values shown), reproductions relying on those exact numeric matrices may be underdetermined unless the same Laplacian setup and periodic boundary conditions (grid_shape) are used.

Tolerance and dtype/precision are referenced via variables (atol) and np.float64 in the code, but their concrete numeric values are not stated; using different test tolerances could change whether the numerical assertions fail.
